receipt.evidence_limits: Read-only full-candidate diagnostic, not a retrained ablation. Native matcher is applied to evaluation inputs; unmatched status is not physical background identity. IoU qualification and overlap against detection-vocabulary scene GT are GT-only geometric proxies, not a deployed selection rule. Root GT is scored independently even when excluded from the detection-vocabulary scene list; that exclusion is recorded. All 256 are kept; no new pruning, supervision or optimizer update. Fresh forward may differ numerically from archived formal output.
